text:
ana: quick question on parity: ruby sdk's default retry/backoff differs from python. ruby retries 3x with linear backoff, python uses exp backoff 5x. we got a bug report from a customer hitting transient 503s while streaming. should we align behavior or document the difference?

ravi: +1 align. customers expect similar UX across languages. exp backoff is better for bursty infra.

jo: agree. also note streaming reconnect logic is slightly different: ruby tear-downs the stream on 401 and doesn't attempt refresh; python tries refresh once. that explains the customer repro.

ana: (typo, meant ana) i can open a small PR to change ruby to 5 retries with jittered exp backoff and add a `REDWOOD_RETRY_POLICY` env var for overrides. anyone opposed?

ravi: sounds good. keep default conservative for Hosted (we can tune per-model later). add a feature-flag so Dedicated customers can opt into aggressive retries.

jo: for the streaming 401 case let's add a short circuit: if 401 and token source is env var, do not prompt or refresh; if token source is keyring/file and refresh token flow is configured, attempt a single refresh then reconnect. add tests for both flows.

dev-bot: :gear: PR checklist reminder: unit tests, changelog entry, and update sample-apps README.

ana: here's the minimal sample-app snippet to show recommended auth pattern:

```ruby
# sample-apps/ruby/minimal.rb
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.chat.create(model: 'redwood-alpha', input: 'hi')
puts resp.text
```

ana: maybe add a tiny `on_auth_error` hook example to catch 401 and attempt refresh.

ravi: +1. also run CI on the PR against windows/mac/linux matrix. last time the matrix flaked because of a global net dependency in integration tests. we should mock network for unit tests and keep integrational coverage limited.

ci-bot: :robot_face: FYI, flaky test identified in `test_stream_reconnect` on macOS runner. see issue #521: https://ci.example.com/521/logs

jo: i'll take the test flake. can we also add a small migration guide in docs/ruby.md explaining the retry change and how to opt-out? customers on Dedicated might care about latency impact.

ana: will do. i'll open PR 309 with code + tests + docs today. link when ready. thanks all :sparkles:
